title: Police Blotter: 18 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: 18 people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026 — including 9 alleged DWI bookings, plus federal and immigration holds. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Eighteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on alleged misdemeanor charges and holds on Friday, October 30, 2026, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

DAVILA, DARIO

DAVILA, DARIO was arrested on Friday, October 30, 2026, at 3:07 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department on an alleged charge of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor. Bond had not been set at the time of booking.

Bond had not been set on three of the counts at the time of booking; bond was set at $10,000 on one driving-while-intoxicated count and $1,000 on one marijuana-possession count.
